description: This is a PHP unit test class for the EmployeeAllowedSkillAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It tests the API's methods such as getAll, create, delete, and their validation rules, focusing on the EmployeeAllowedSkillAPI functionality within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeAllowedSkillAPITest
classes.description: This class tests various endpoints of the EmployeeAllowedSkillAPI, including retrieving allowed skills, validation rules, and handling unimplemented operations in the HRM system.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the delete operation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests that the create operation throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the create operation.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all allowed skills for an employee, mocks DAO and service responses, verifies output structure.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for fetching all allowed skills, including role-based access control.
